name: plan-architect
description: Turn a settled design into a walking-skeleton execution plan. Four phases (Inventory, Spine, Milestones, Validation) produce inventory.md, spine.md and plan.md, where the first milestone walks the thinnest end-to-end path through the system and each later one thickens it along a single axis. A validator then checks that every criterion is delivered by exactly one milestone, dependencies point backwards, and M1 spans the whole spine — so a horizontally sliced plan fails instead of shipping. Scoped to delivery order only — no architecture decisions, no task breakdown.
